tasks.title: Scaffold bun monorepo, single Worker with static assets, and local dev loop
Test harness: vitest-pool-workers, web vitest, Playwright, all guarded to local-only
Request pipeline: validation, request id, security headers, error handling, SPA fallthrough
Health endpoint on /health and /api/health with injected version metadata
Test-only /test/* routes (reset, throw) gated off in production
Unit tests: request validation, header finalization, health builder, test-env guard
Integration tests: Worker request handling, health, SPA fallback, test-route gating, storage isolation
E2E: developer golden path and headers on a real document load
Deploy building blocks: migration safety scan, idempotency check, retry, health verification and release record
Unit tests: safety scan, idempotency, retry, health verification, CSV formatting
Release command: bun deploy script orchestrating prechecks, scan, migrations, publish, verify, record
Integration tests: release pipeline end to end with fake wrangler, real git, fs and health server
